scientific_goal: Evaluate whether an already-completed one-chain Boltz2 FN1 type II domain fragment reproduces experimental backbone geometry/contact patterns from the identical amino-acid segment of published NMR structures; report all models, not best-of.

existing_rowan.protein: human fibronectin FN1 type II repeats segment 355–463 inclusive

source_checks: Verified via live RCSB polymer entity API on Yaksa: target 109aa matches both full 160aa polymer sequences at zero-based offset 50, and both RCSB polymer sequences match the frozen full sequence. Executor must fail closed on any sequence drift.

reference_lineage.common_publication: Pickford et al EMBO J (2001), PMID 11285216
reference_lineage.reference_contains_extra_N_terminal_FnI_: 6F1 upstream of two FnII modules: first 50 residues absent from Rowan short-chain prediction
reference_lineage.reference_contains_one_extra_C_terminal_: Reference has one additional C-terminal alanine beyond predicted region

precommitted_methods.alignment: global sequence identity mapping, no mismatches; target residues 1-109 fixed; do not choose best segment, window, reference chain, or model
precommitted_methods.global_CA_RMSD: Kabsch SVD, Angstrom, one value per each reference model
precommitted_methods.GDT_TS_like: fractions of matching CAs within 1, 2, 4, 8 Angstrom averaged; not official TM-score
precommitted_methods.pairwise_distance_rmsd: all exact mapped target CA pairs with residue sequence separation >=4
precommitted_methods.ensemble_primary_summary: median and full min-max range across ALL 20 models of 1E88 (no best-only selection)
precommitted_methods.secondary_ref_summary: 1E8B single model separately; treat as same-publication sensitivity analysis, not independent study
precommitted_methods.consistency: match 160aa experimental polymer sequence with frozen 1E88 full-string exactly for both PDB ids; 1E8B no alternate mapping
precommitted_methods.no_new_computation: Provider read-only fetch of already completed workflow; no submit API, no Rowan credits
assertion_limits: Single-chain FN1 vs three-module experimental NMR context differs structurally
NMR conformers are correlated outcomes of one study
No inference on native placental ECM or BC binding
No lab/clinical blind validation or ΔΔG
No model retraining or production promotion
